case.title: Calm cancellation request
case.subject: Cancelling
case.text:
Hello, I'm retiring at the end of the year and closing my massage practice, so I'd like to cancel my Slotwise subscription. Thank you for the good service over the years. What happens to my client list?

George
case.why: Cancellation is self-serve; not angry, so no escalation. Reply should explain steps, export, and 30-day data retention.

output.reply:
Hello George,

Congratulations on your retirement, and thank you for being with us over the years. Here is how to cancel and what happens to your client list.

To cancel, sign in as the account owner and go to Settings → Billing → Cancel subscription. There is no cancellation fee or notice period. Your account stays active until the end of the current billing period, and you won't be charged again. After that, your booking page goes offline and reminders stop.

Your data, including your client list, is kept for 30 days after the period ends. If you reactivate within that time, everything is restored. After 30 days it is permanently deleted.

Before cancelling, you can export your client list and appointment history from Settings → Data → Export. You'll receive an email with a download link, valid for 7 days. You may also want to tell your clients that your booking link will stop working.

If you'd like your data deleted sooner, email us and our privacy team will handle it.

Slotwise Support
